items.name: analyze_authored_source
items.requiredTruth: Product analyzes the authored manual source through the manual boundary.

items.name: immutable_source_admission
items.requiredTruth: Product admits one immutable manual source authority.

items.name: source_round_trip
items.requiredTruth: Every authored source string and one-based manual ordinal round-trips unchanged.

items.name: reviewable_proposal
items.requiredTruth: The proposal preserves manual source, object appArea, canonical 0/1 actions, exact grounding, oracle, and authentication authority.

items.name: identity_only_save
items.requiredTruth: Save accepts source and proposal identities only and rejects semantic bodies.

items.name: current_reanalysis
items.requiredTruth: Save reanalyzes current evidence before promotion.

items.name: exact_reviewed_promotion
items.requiredTruth: Promotion binds the exact reviewed proposal identity and content authority.

items.name: canonical_v3_unchanged
items.requiredTruth: The promoted canonical v3 preserves normalized intent, appArea, actions, oracle, and authentication expectation unchanged while manual promotion provenance remains external.

items.name: m2_candidate_exact
items.requiredTruth: The promoted Definition becomes an existing M2 candidate using exact Definition/Test Set authority without translation.

items.name: run_result_unchanged
items.requiredTruth: Existing execution and Result behavior consumes the promoted v3 authority unchanged.

items.name: presentation_provenance
items.requiredTruth: Definition presentation preserves immutable external manual source and proposal promotion provenance.

items.name: historical_provenance
items.requiredTruth: Historical Results retain the accepted external manual promotion provenance and never float to current authority.
